translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Yave wa mambu ma busonga bu ndieti samba ;
dimba yamikina kuama ;
tamba kutu mu lusambulu luama
lueti totukila mu bididi bikambulu luvunu.
Bika ndungunu ama yitotukila kuidi ngeyo
ayi bika meso maku mamona momo madi ma lulama.
Ka diambu ko tidi fiongunina ntimꞌama,
ayi kuthala va builu
ka diambu ko wumbekini, mu mbazu wulendi mona kadi kiasa ko.
Ndibaka lukanu ti munu ama
wulendi sumuka ko.
Mu diambu di mavanga ma batu ;
mu nzila yi mambu ma bididi biaku,
ndieti kukikeba mu nzila yi mutu widi matsita.
Bitambi biama bidi kaka bikinda
mu minsolo miaku,
malu mama malendi sialumuka ko.
A Nzambi, ndikutela bila ngeyo wela kuphana mvutu.
Yinika dikutu diaku ku ndidi
ayi wa lusambulu luama.
Monisa matsiminanga ma luzolo luaku lunneni,
ngeyo wuphukisanga mu koko kuaku ku lubakala
bobo bansuaminanga mu ngeyo,
mu bobo bakubalendanga.
Wukheba banga ngengele yi dieso diaku ;
wutsueki ku tsi kitsusula ki mavavi maku,
mu diambu di batu bambimbi beti kundiamisa,
mu diambu di bambeni ziama zieti kunzungidila ;
ziosi zintomba lufua luama.
Bakikangidi mintima miawu midi banga matadi ;
Miunu miawu mintubanga mambu ma lunanga.
Balembo ndandakana,
banzungididi buabu ; balembo tadi
mu diambu bambuisa va tsi.
Badedikini banga khosi yidi nzala kanzuna,
banga khosi yiyunduka yidi yilambididi va buangu kisuama.
Telama, Yave, wuba nuanisa
ayi bika wuba buisa,
wukhula mu sabala kiaku ;
mu mutu wumbimbi.
A Yave, bika wuphukisa mu koko kuaku mu batu ba phila yayi ;
batu ba ntoto wawu ; bobo mfutu awu widi mu luzingu lualu.
Weti lembika nzala yi bobo weti zola
bana bawu babeki biwombo,
ayi balundila bana bawu batsombi kimvuama.
Vayi minu, ndiela mona zizi kiaku mu busonga.
Bu ndiela kotuka ndiela yukuta mu talanga mfikulꞌaku.
